Name: Rain Tuner
Author: link007113
Description:
[b]Rain Tuner[/b]: Customize the chance of rain per season and force tomorrow’s weather with a single hotkey.
Compatible with SMAPI 4.3.2 and Stardew Valley 1.6.x.
[line]✨ Features[list]
[*][b]Seasonal precipitation chances[/b]
[list]
[*]Spring: 25%
[*]Summer: 15%
[*]Fall: 50%
[*]Winter: 80% (snow)
[*]All values configurable via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b]
[/list][*][b]Precipitation type selection (non-winter)[/b]
[list]
[*]Normal Rain
[*]Storms (lightning)
[*]Green Rain (by default only on eligible summer days: 5, 6, 7, 14, 16, 18, 23)
[*]All weighted and configurable
[/list][*][b]Force precipitation tomorrow with a hotkey[/b]
[list]
[*]Default: [b]F9[/b]
[/list][/list][b][list]
[*]Force sunny weather tomorrow with a hotkey
[list]
[*]Default: F10
[/list][/list][/b][list]
[*][b]Options[/b]
[list]
[*]Respect festivals and weddings
[*]Force sunny weather if the chance roll fails (for tighter distribution)
[*][b]Override settings[/b][list]
[*][i]Allow Green Rain override[/i]: ignore vanilla restrictions and allow Green Rain any summer day
[*][i]Allow Spring Year 1 override[/i]: ignore vanilla’s fixed weather on Spring 1–5 Year 1
[/list]
[/list][*][b]Safe for existing saves[/b]
[/list][line]📦 Requirements[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.x[/b]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.3.2+[/b]
[*](Optional) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game configuration ([b]Use latest version[/b])
[/list][line]🔧 Installation
[list=1]
[*]Click [b]“Mod Manager Download”[/b] or add the zip manually to Vortex
[*]Enable the mod
[*]Launch the game via [b]SMAPI[/b]
[/list]Manual[list=1]
[*]Extract the [code]RainTuner[/code] folder into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]
[*]Launch the game via [b]SMAPI[/b]
[/list][line]⚙️ Configuration
﻿Available through [b]GMCM or config.json[/b]:
[list]
[*]Seasonal chances (Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter Snow)
[*]Weights for Rain, Storms, and Green Rain
[*]Hotkey for forcing precipitation (default: F9)
[*]Respect festivals & weddings
[*]Force sunny if roll fails
[*]Overrides:[list]
[*]Allow Green Rain override
[*]Allow Spring Year 1 override
[/list]
[/list][line]🎮 Usage[list]
[*]Want precipitation tomorrow? → Press the hotkey.
[*]In winter → always snow.
[*]In other seasons → type is chosen based on configured weights (Rain, Storm, Green Rain).
[*]Want strict percentages? → Keep [i]Force sunny on failure[/i] enabled.
[*]Want to bypass vanilla restrictions (Green Rain / Year 1 Spring)? → Enable the override options.
[/list][line]🛠️ How It Works[list]
[*]At day’s end, Rain Tuner rolls your configured chance.
[*]On success → picks a type (Rain, Storm, Green Rain, or Snow in winter).
[*]On failure (with [i]Force sunny[/i] enabled) → sets Sunny.
[*]Hotkey sets tomorrow’s weather directly using the same logic.
[*]Festival/wedding days are protected if the option is enabled.
[/list][line]👥 Multiplayer[list]
[*]Weather is [b]host-determined[/b].
[*]Only the [b]host[/b] needs this mod for effects to apply.
[*]Non-hosts can install safely, but it won’t affect the session.
[/list][line]🔄 Compatibility[list]
[*]Compatible with [b]SMAPI 4.3.2+[/b] and Stardew Valley [b]1.6.x[/b]
[*]Works alongside most content mods
[*]Mods that also set tomorrow’s weather may conflict → last mod wins
[*]For best predictability: enable [i]Force sunny[/i] and load this mod last
[*]Check [code]SMAPI-latest.txt[/code] for [code]Rain Tuner[/code] messages
[/list][line]Overrides[list]
[*][b]Green Rain override[/b] → allow Green Rain on any summer day (instead of vanilla’s limited set)
[*][b]Spring Year 1 override[/b] → ignore vanilla’s forced weather on Spring 1–5 in Year 1
[*]Both options can be toggled in GMCM
[*]If disabled, Rain Tuner will follow vanilla’s restrictions and show an in-game + log warning
[/list][list]
[/list][line]⚠️ Known Issues[list]
[*]Conflicts possible with overhaul mods that fully replace weather logic.
[/list][line]🙏 Credits[list]
[*]Code: [b]Link007[/b]
[*]Thanks to the [b]SMAPI team[/b] and the [b]modding community[/b]
[*][b]Header and Readme [/b]are mostly generated by AI. The mod is simply artisan-made.
[/list]
